language_task: Put the green plastic broccoli into the bowl.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the broccoli in frames 20–63 (wrist_cam and right_base_cam), then lifts and transports it over the bowl in frames 65–83 (right_base_cam and left_base_cam). Frames 84–90 in wrist_cam show release and the broccoli settling inside the bowl. It remains in the bowl through frame 108 in left_base_cam and right_base_cam as the gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
